forum.title: Boot stuck on a custom board after upgrading to the latest meta-st-stm32mp release
forum.category: STM32 MPUs Embedded software and solutions
forum.best_answer_content: OK so I have found the issue: I have missed this commit <https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/linux/commit/943bbd7f5c66dc6bd04de05683661b4e9292c0a2> which changed the clocks used by the GPIOs to use SCMI ones.
forum.content_text:
Hi everyone,

I have recently upgraded from openstlinux-6.6-yocto-scarthgap-mpu-v25.06.11 to openstlinux-6.6-yocto-scarthgap-mpu-v26.02.18 of the meta-st-stm32mp layer.

scraped_replies.html: OK so I have found the issue: I have missed this commit https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/linux/commit/943bbd7f5c66dc6bd04de05683661b4e9292c0a2 which changed the clocks used by the GPIOs to use SCMI ones.
scraped_replies.author: JocelynMeyron
